name: scoop
description: Scoop, a Chrome MV3 extension. Point at an element and copy it to your clipboard.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build --mode content && vite build --mode background
scripts.dev: npm run clean && (vite build --watch --mode content & vite build --watch --mode background & wait)
scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true})" && rm -f release/scoop-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../release/scoop-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
